title: 96-well Plasmid ezFilter Miniprep Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause to swap plates and reagents (protocol pause specifies exact steps).

steps.title: Add Buffer A1
steps.instruction: Add Buffer A1 to each sample as indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Pause and swap plates (first)
steps.instruction: Pause the run and swap plates and reagents according to the protocol‑specified instructions.

steps.title: Add Buffer A2
steps.instruction: Add Buffer A2 to each sample as indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Pause and swap plates (second)
steps.instruction: Pause the run and swap plates and reagents according to the protocol‑specified instructions.

steps.title: Add Buffer N3
steps.instruction: Add Buffer N3 to each sample as indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Move samples to plates
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples to plate 3 if only one plate is selected, or to plates 3 and 6 if two plates are selected.

steps.title: Pause and swap plates (third)
steps.instruction: Pause the run and swap plates and reagents according to the protocol‑specified instructions.

steps.title: Add isopropanol and transfer
steps.instruction: Add isopropanol to the samples, then move the samples to a new plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the isopropanol‑treated samples to the designated new plate.

steps.title: Add wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add wash buffer to each sample as indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer to each sample as indicated in the protocol.
